RJHSE-5384 (single port, right angle, shield, LED code 4: LED2 left green, LED1 right yellow; RJHSE-catalog-pp3-7-raster.pdf#p1) replaces RJHSE5M80 (D71az). Contacts 1-8, two 3.25 mm pegs and two shield pads are the same pattern as before; the stock KiCad footprint RJ45_Amphenol_RJHSE538X adds LED pins 9-12 on a 6.6 mm row. LED pins from the maker LED schematic (component-side view), RJHSE-X38X-A4-drawing.pdf#p1: 12 = LED2 anode, 11 = LED2 cathode, 10 = LED1 anode, 9 = LED1 cathode. Not drawn for the single-port part itself (the drawing is the 4-port -X38X-A4): confirm LED polarity with a meter on the first sample.
